title: Case Study A: GUM-compliant uncertainty quantification for RUL estimation on the ZeMA electromechanical cylinder dataset
description: Supplementary material (code, results, reports and figures) for Case Study A of the paper: remaining-useful-life estimation with a neural network on the ZeMA electromechanical cylinder dataset, with a GUM-compliant uncertainty budget computed by the law of propagation of uncertainty and by Monte Carlo (JCGM 101). The ZeMA dataset is not included; the scripts download it from Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.5185953).
